parts.text: A student determines the resistance of a resistance wire. Fig. 2.1 shows the circuit he uses. Fig. 2.1

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) • The student places the sliding contact C on the resistance wire at a distance l = 10.0 cm from B. • Record, in the first row of Table 2.1, the potential difference V across the length l = 10.0 cm of resistance wire, as shown on the voltmeter in Fig. 2.2. Fig. 2.2 Fig. 2.3 • Record, in the first row of Table 2.1, the current I in the circuit as shown in Fig. 2.3. • Complete the column headings in Table 2.1.
